# i3dnet_network_prefixes (Data Source)

Lists the IP prefixes (address ranges) on your account, including prefixes created outside Terraform. Prefixes created through a network's initial prefixes appear here too. All filters are optional and combine: a prefix is returned only if it matches every filter that is set. Terraform only reads the prefixes: it does not manage, change or destroy them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the IPv4 prefixes of one network, for example to build a firewall allowlist.
data "i3dnet_network_prefixes" "web_ipv4" {
  network_id = "01928f3e-7c4a-7b1e-9d2f-3a5b6c7d8e9f"
  family     = 4
}

output "web_ipv4_cidrs" {
  value = [for p in data.i3dnet_network_prefixes.web_ipv4.prefixes : p.cidr if p.cidr != null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fabric` (String) Return only prefixes in this fabric, a `slug` from `i3dnet_fabrics`. Cannot be used together with `metro`.
- `family` (Number) Return only prefixes of this IP family: `4` for IPv4 or `6` for IPv6.
- `metro` (String) Return only prefixes in this metro area, a `metro` from `i3dnet_fabrics`. Cannot be used together with `fabric`.
- `network_id` (String) Return only prefixes on the network with this ID (UUID). This can include older prefixes on the same VLAN that were not created through the network: those have a null `network_id`.

### Read-Only

- `prefixes` (Attributes List) Prefixes that match the filters. An empty list when none match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefixes))

<a id="nestedatt--prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefixes`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) The prefix in CIDR notation, for example `203.0.113.0/28`. Null while the prefix is still being provisioned: i3D.net has not picked the addresses yet.
- `contract_id` (String) Contract the prefix is billed under. Null when none is recorded, for example on an `ephemeral` prefix.
- `created_at` (String) When the prefix was created (RFC 3339). Null when not known.
- `customer_description` (String) Your description of the prefix. Null when never set.
- `fabric` (String) Fabric (i3D.net location) of the prefix, a `slug` from `i3dnet_fabrics`. Null when the prefix has no fabric.
- `family` (Number) IP family: `4` for IPv4 or `6` for IPv6.
- `gateway_ip` (String) Gateway IP address of the prefix. Null when the prefix has no gateway, for example on a private prefix.
- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the prefix.
- `metro` (String) Metro area of the prefix's fabric. Null when `fabric` is null.
- `network_id` (String) ID of the network the prefix was created through. Null for prefixes that are not part of a network.
- `retention` (String) `persistent` (stays until it is deleted) or `ephemeral` (i3D.net set it up for your account and removes it again together with what it was set up for). Null for prefixes created before retention existed.
- `router_ips` (List of String) IP addresses of the i3D.net routers that serve the prefix. Null when no routers are recorded.
- `state` (String) State of the prefix, for example `provisioning`, `active` or `failed`. More values can appear, such as `reserved`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the prefix last changed (RFC 3339). Null when not known.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID the prefix is on. Null when the prefix has no VLAN.
